description: Which diamine supply genes separate Type II genomes, with Bonferroni correction over the 7 genes tested
code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.stats import fisher_exact
OUT="/agent/jobs/ddbdc7c3-ea00-49cb-a873-e155d8048779/provenance"
K=pd.read_csv(f"{OUT}/kegg_diamine_supply_by_pocket_type.csv")
K["ADC"]=((K.K01584==1)|(K.K01585==1)).astype(int)
GEN={"K13745":"ddc, DABA-DC (-> 1,3-diaminopropane)","ADC":"speA, Arg decarboxylase (-> agmatine)",
     "K01581":"speC, Orn decarboxylase (-> putrescine)","K01480":"speB, agmatinase (agmatine -> putrescine)",
     "K13747":"nspC, carboxy(nor)spermidine decarboxylase","K01611":"speD (classical route)","K00797":"speE (classical route)"}
res=[]
for g,nm in GEN.items():
    inII=K[K.pocket_type=="Type II"][g]; out=K[K.pocket_type!="Type II"][g]
    a,b=int(inII.sum()),int(len(inII)-inII.sum()); c,d=int(out.sum()),int(len(out)-out.sum())
    _,p=fisher_exact([[a,b],[c,d]])
    res.append(dict(gene=g, name=nm, TypeII=f"{a}/{a+b}", other=f"{c}/{c+d}", p=p))
R=pd.DataFrame(res).sort_values("p")
R["p_bonferroni"]=(R.p*len(R)).clip(upper=1.0)
R.to_csv(f"{OUT}/kegg_typeII_enrichment.csv", index=False)
print("Type II genomes vs all others, 12 genomes, 7 genes tested:")
print(R[["name","TypeII","other","p","p_bonferroni"]].to_string(index=False, float_format=lambda v:f"{v:.4g}"))

print("\nper-type gene presence (n per type: %s)"%K.pocket_type.value_counts().to_dict())
piv=K.groupby("pocket_type")[["K13745","ADC","K01581","K01480","K13747","K01611","K00797"]].agg(["sum","size"])
print(K.groupby("pocket_type")[["K13745","ADC","K01581","K01480"]].sum().to_string())

fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2, figsize=(15,5.4), gridspec_kw={"width_ratios":[1.35,1]})
ax=axes[0]
genes=["K13745","ADC","K01581","K01480","K13747","K01611","K00797"]
lab=["ddc\n->DAP","speA/ADC\n->agmatine","speC/ODC\n->putrescine","speB\nagmatinase","nspC","speD","speE"]
cols={"Type I":"#2E7D5B","Type II":"#B03030","Type III":"#3A6EA5"}
K2=K.sort_values(["pocket_type","organism"]).reset_index(drop=True)
ax.imshow(K2[genes].values.astype(float), cmap="Greys", vmin=0, vmax=1.75, aspect="auto")
ax.set_xticks(range(len(genes))); ax.set_xticklabels(lab, fontsize=9.5)
ax.set_yticks(range(len(K2))); ax.set_yticklabels(K2.organism, fontsize=10)
for t,c in zip(ax.get_yticklabels(), K2.pocket_type.map(cols)): t.set_color(c)
for i in range(len(K2)):
    for j,g in enumerate(genes):
        if K2.loc[i,g]==1: ax.text(j,i,"+",ha="center",va="center",color="white",fontsize=13,weight="bold")
for bn in np.where(K2.pocket_type.values[1:]!=K2.pocket_type.values[:-1])[0]: ax.axhline(bn+0.5,color="k",lw=1.8)
ax.set_title("A  Diamine supply genes by pocket type of the resident PF03435 member (KEGG, 12 genomes)\n"
             "green Type I (characterised), red Type II (PP_2928), blue Type III (CANSDH)", fontsize=11, loc="left")
ax=axes[1]
y=np.arange(len(R)); ax.barh(y, -np.log10(R.p.values), color=["#B03030" if v<0.05 else "#999" for v in R.p])
ax.set_yticks(y); ax.set_yticklabels([n.split(",")[0] for n in R.name], fontsize=10)
ax.axvline(-np.log10(0.05), color="k", ls="--", lw=1.2); ax.text(-np.log10(0.05)+0.03, 0.2, "p = 0.05", fontsize=9)
ax.axvline(-np.log10(0.05/7), color="k", ls=":", lw=1.2); ax.text(-np.log10(0.05/7)+0.03, 0.2, "Bonferroni", fontsize=9)
ax.set_xlabel("-log10 Fisher p, Type II genomes vs the rest", fontsize=10.5)
ax.set_title("B  Only speC/ODC separates Type II,\nand it does not survive correction (n = 12)", fontsize=11, loc="left")
for sp in ["top","right"]: ax.spines[sp].set_visible(False)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
